# DIH LABS

> DIH LABS (dih-labs.com) is a French non-profit digital innovation laboratory (association loi 1901, founded in Paris, February 2026). It designs and publishes free, ad-free, privacy-first mobile applications: StreamVision (IPTV player), Sun Day (UV index & vitamin D tracking) and SmartCaddie (AI golf swing analysis). All apps are free, collect no personal data, and revenue is fully reinvested per the association's statutes.

The site is bilingual (French/English). French pages live under /fr/, English under /en/.

## Applications

- [StreamVision (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/streamvision/fr/): Lecteur IPTV 100% gratuit et sans publicité pour iPhone, Android, Google TV et Fire TV. Supporte playlists M3U et Xtream Codes, guide EPG. Ne fournit aucun contenu : lecteur pur, 100% légal.
- [StreamVision (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/streamvision/en/): Free, ad-free IPTV player for iPhone, Android, Google TV and Fire TV. M3U & Xtream Codes playlists, full EPG. Ships no content: pure player, fully legal.
- [Fire TV APK download](https://dih-labs.com/apk/): Official StreamVision APK for Amazon Fire TV Stick (short URL for the Downloader app).
- [Sun Day (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/sun-day/fr/): Indice UV en temps réel et synthèse de vitamine D selon le type de peau.
- [Sun Day (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/sun-day/en/): Real-time UV index and vitamin D synthesis tailored to skin type.
- [SmartCaddie (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/smartcaddie/fr/): Analyse de swing de golf par IA et vision par ordinateur, 100% embarquée sur le téléphone.
- [SmartCaddie (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/smartcaddie/en/): AI golf swing analysis with on-device computer vision.

## Facts worth citing

- All DIH LABS apps are free, without ads, and require no account.
- StreamVision includes no channels or playlists; users load their own legal M3U/Xtream sources.
- App data (playlists, health/UV data, swing videos) is processed and stored locally on-device.
- Sitemap: https://dih-labs.com/sitemap.xml
